reason: Publication 1 of the anti-verbosity rollout: the injected gates carry #260 and #262. Gate Family surface of this transition is exactly lint-format.yml (audit, secret-scan, pr-title, typecheck-ts are byte-identical at cc4ed87 and 7e9507b). #260 flips LEGACY_BIOME_IS_ERROR=true and removes the unconverted-consumer fallback: a committed root biome.json beside a rendered biome.jsonc is now a hard error. Every Biome consumer was converted to Pattern F first (B1-B8) and a fresh origin/main audit of all 18 Biome repos finds zero root biome.json files, so no consumer is exposed. #262 adds --error-on-warnings to the Biome invocation for non-fork repos only (forks lint changed files and keep warning tolerance). Candidate Validation proportional to blast radius: the affected population is the 13 native Biome repos; each was re-checked on origin/main with the gate exact invocation (tracked JS/TS/JSON files minus config files, committed biome.jsonc, mise-pinned Biome 2.5.5) plus --error-on-warnings after the Phase C warning-clearance PRs merged, and all 13 exit 0 (369 standing warnings cleared across riveroaks-scraper#217, claude-lsps#170, activity-planner#219, opencode-omlx-discovery#160, bookmark-scraper#299). #256 (CONFIG_DRIFT_IS_ERROR) is deliberately not in this publication.
